about.en: gib (༼ つ ◕_◕ ༽つ) is a meme coin on Hedera, token 0.0.7893707 (EVM address 0x00000000000000000000000000000000007872cb), named after the ASCII "gib" copypasta. It is the GIB Kraken lists. It is a different token from gib on Solana (gib, 6FtbGaqgZzti1TxJksBV4PSya5of9VqA9vJNDxPwbonk), which trades at a far lower unit price.
